name: The St. Regis Abu Dhabi
positioning: St. Regis hotel in Nation Tower on the Abu Dhabi Corniche, with direct access to the private Nation Riviera Beach Club
best_for: Travelers who want a city hotel on the Corniche with beach club access
Guests who want St. Regis butler service and several restaurants and bars in one building

facts.text: The hotel's address is Nation Tower, on the Corniche in Abu Dhabi.
The hotel is adjacent to the Nation Galleria Mall, which has more than 60 retail shops and a cinema.
The hotel is close to the Al Bateen district, Qasr Al Watan and Emirates Palace.
Zayed International Airport is about 8.8 kilometers from the hotel.
Rooms are finished in Statuario Royal marble with hand-tufted wool carpeting.
Marble bathrooms have dual vanities, bathtubs and separate showers with rain shower heads.
The hotel offers signature 24-hour St. Regis Butler Service, with a Butler Service desk for guest requests.
Villa Toscana serves regional Italian specialties with Italian wines, in a decor inspired by a Tuscan villa.
Catch at St. Regis is a seafood restaurant highlighting caviar, oysters, sushi and crabs.
Azura Panoramic Lounge sits on the pool terrace, with Corniche views and a Mediterranean and Moroccan-inspired menu.
The St. Regis Spa covers 3,200 square meters.

highlights.text: The Abu Dhabi Suite spans two stories on the 48th and 49th floors, with 360-degree views.
Guests have direct access to the private Nation Riviera Beach Club, which has a sandy beach, a swimming pool, a fitness center and a kids club.
Crystal Lounge serves signature afternoon tea and champagne on the mezzanine above the Grand Staircase, beneath a chandelier of blown glass art.
The St. Regis Bar has three spaces and evokes New York's Gilded Age.
The book-lined Library has a barrel-vaulted ceiling and offers workstations and iPads with newspapers from around the world.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; a paid luxury car service is available by reservation.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's high-end positioning.
